name: page
need: Lay out a page: its head (sticky and condensing, actions that fold into More), breadcrumbs, columns of cards, and a sign-in page

--ds-stack-gap.description: `.ds-stack`; a stack directly in the page and `.ds-stack--page`

--ds-stack-gap-page.description: `.ds-stack`; a stack directly in the page and `.ds-stack--page`

--ds-page-head-text-basis.description: the room the page head's title and lead take before the actions wrap under them

--ds-page-head-title-line.description: the title line the page head's actions centre on (set it with a theme that changes `--ds-font-headline`)

--ds-page-head-top.description: where a sticky page head (`.ds-page-head--sticky`) stops below the top of its scroller (the height of a bar that sticks above it)

--ds-page-head-bg.description: the ground under a sticky page head, so the content scrolls away under it

--ds-breadcrumbs-item-max.description: a breadcrumb item before its ellipsis

labExempt.DS.page.fold: arithmetic of the folding actions (which ones stay in the row), no motion of its own
